title: DeepSeek · 博客来源更新
summary: 博客更新：与 changelog 同步，模型名称说明更新为 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 提供服务，并新增 Search/Fetch API 上线公告。

pairs.before: (1) Use deepseek-flash as the model name. The legacy names deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp are still accepted, but the corresponding models have been retired, their requests are served by the DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash model and billed at the Flash price.
pairs.after: (1) Use deepseek-flash as the model name. It is now served by DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, and the calling method remains unchanged. The legacy names deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp are still accepted, but the corresponding models have been retired; their requests are served by DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 and billed at the Flash price.

added_lines: Search / Fetch API is now available, powered by our in-house search engine and supporting web search and fetch. Click here to view the guide.
